senses.gloss: (b. h.) to move in excitement; to crowd; to quarrel.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 801">Yalk. Deut. 801</cite> <he>רוֹגְנִין</he>; v., however, <cite ref="T00406"><he>רוֹנָן</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to crowd together (in discontent); to be surrounded by a crowd; to create discontent.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 16b:17">Nidd. 16ᵇ</cite> (a variant to <he>הנרגל</he>, v. <cite ref="T00202"><he>רָגַל</he></cite>) (<he>בבית המשתאות</he>) <he>שר הנִרְגָּן</he> a magistrate (or scholar) that is surrounded by a crowd (whom he incites to riot) in drinking houses.

senses.gloss: to heap, cast, (with דברים, cmp. טוּחַ) to speak rebelliously, reproach.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>נרגן</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 16:28">Prov. XVI, 28</cite>) <he>זה הנחש … שר׳ ד׳ וכ׳</he> that is the serpent … that spoke rebelliously against his Creator; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 956:6">Yalk. Prov. 956</cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16">Num. R. s. 16</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 18:8">Prov. XVIII, 8</cite> <he>נרגן</he>, a.

<cite ref="Deuteronomy 1:27">Deut. I, 27</cite> <he>ותרגנו</he>) <he>דברים שרִגְּניּ אחר וכ׳</he> (or <he>שרָגְנוּ</he>) the words which they cast up behind the Lord, caused them great distress; Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 11; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 743:3">Yalk. Num. 743</cite>.
